Three things. (1) The stage critics at S2 and S4 could not fill their own handoff form (the author form path and its sha256; a template question row), and I had to repair the forms by hand four times - the factory should write what it already knows into the form, and never read a template row as a question. (2) The conductor diagnosed every stop correctly, but its moves (restart, go on, resume) were refused by the move table for carrying arguments or the wrong token, so I got a generic retry/go on/stop question instead of its own words - the conductor must be able to act on what it found. (3) The three manual-agent cases (TC_014, TC_015, TC_016) were never checked by hand: their preparation failed with a TypeError, so the exploratory recorder never ran, and the report has no manual observations at all. Also: the code critic rejected 11 tests without typed findings, so the automator repaired blind and three windows ended in debt.

rework

One more round for TC_001 and TC_002: the earlier rejections named no typed finding, so the author could not know what to fix. The author has written the tests again; the code reviewer reviews them now and names each finding with its cause.
